scope: One controlled correction of missing empty-gripper/open-drawer pre-grasp query coverage. No environment complexity expansion; no encoder,transition,loss,architecture,threshold,controller or interface change. No new AB/C collection.
causal_evidence: Previous head-only coverage update changed empty-open readout from original6/6 to0/6 on C; original transition held fixed. Actual AB pre-grasp observations exist but were absent from previous new48 training states.

data.source_root_split: same existing12AB roots,4 percolour; all9valid; predeclared phase before grasp, no outcome filtering
data.C: same old/new C-selection only; C-validation is now previously seen development backtest, never selection; D3 not used in training/selection
data.D4: 12 unseen initial configurations in same physical environmentD,4 percolour; no complexity added

0.selection: minimum equal-weight old/new C-select root-macro masked loss, earlier tie

1.selection: minimum equal-weight old/new C-select root-macro masked loss, earlier tie

query_training.contrast: Exactly3 of20 shared-old draws replaced by new empty-open draws. Remaining17 old +12 existing-intermediate draws identical. Original sample schedule first600 updates reused; initialization identical perseed.
query_training.optimizer: same AdamW lr.001 wd.001 clip1, fresh optimizer in both arms
query_training.loss: same original masked HoldingBCE/InBCE/drawerCE mean, same fixed positive weights
query_training.selection: same minimum .5oldC-rootmacro masked loss+.5newC-selection-rootmacro masked loss, earlier tie; include0 to retain starting model if no improvement

collection.conditions: same normal4-skill chain and held-closed4-call branch
collection.failure: retain failed/refused/unreached; no replacement roots, no collect-until-success
collection.reset: native initial xyz/yaw and closed drawer only, not an action transition
collection.full_physical_truth: same immutable9-label definition, full quaternion/contact snapshot; masks remain unknown when uncertain

references: previous C-selected new-coverage head for each seed
evaluation.metrics: same full9 root/state accuracy, perHolding/In/drawer, real-successor vs single-step vs initial-only recursive1..4, paired propositions, old-state retention
evaluation.D4_freeze: all model choices and thresholds sealed before D4 collection, no test adaptation
evaluation.complexity_gate: Do not expand on a targeted gain alone. Require consistent normal and intermediate-state and multi-step improvement in both seeds on independent roots, with no clear other-state regression. This is an expansion decision gate, not replacement of original project acceptance standards.
evaluation.finite_stop: This is one causal correction round, no repeated sampling/threshold tuning on D4. If multi-step remains poor or states regress, report unresolved cause; do not automatically grow complexity.
